caption: The drawing shows a single dark-colored object positioned centrally on a plain, light background. One stem terminates in a cylindrical pipe-like end that is open at the top, while the other extends into a horizontal, flat, rounded plate with a smaller upright extension at one side. The composition is monochromatic, rendered in shades of gray and black. The texture of the object is rough, suggesting a solid and sturdy material. The signature "J.
